public_rationale: ION Analytics reported on July 28, 2026 that SpaceX shares had fallen below their June IPO price and subsequent highs [e3]. Anthropic said on October 26, 2026 that its proposed IPO registration statement was not yet effective [e4]. Neither item establishes sufficient customer retrenchment, resulting failures of all three companies' original projections, or subsequent declines in every relevant stock using the contract's reference price [e3, e4]. The evidence therefore leaves the conditional forecast unresolved.
limitations: The company identities, customer-retrenchment threshold and applicable original projections remain unestablished.
SpaceX's reported decline uses IPO and post-listing prices, not the contract's closing price before disclosure of a projection failure.
The evidence does not provide comparable trading histories for all three companies.
The forecast has no deadline; an interim absence of declines cannot contradict it.

none of the three IPO’ing companies will ever hit their long-term projections
our_interpretation: The sentence inherits the preceding conditions: substantial customer retrenchment and resulting failure of all three companies to achieve their long-term projections.
The ordinary reading is that each company's publicly traded share price subsequently declines.
For a reproducible test, use split-adjusted closing prices relative to the last close before the relevant projection failure became public. This reference price is an evaluator choice.
The post does not specify IPO offer prices as the comparison baseline, so the screening suggestion is not treated as the speaker's commitment.
'Eventually' supplies no deadline. A period without a decline cannot establish failure.
OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX were search candidates; the post itself does not name the companies.
criteria.support_condition: Independently establish customer retrenchment and consequent failure of all three companies to meet their identified original projections. Then show a subsequent share-price decline for each company using the stated comparison rule.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the full antecedent is established, a completed trading history or other decisive event must rule out a subsequent decline for at least one company. Prices remaining higher through the evaluation date are insufficient.

Independently establish sufficient customer retrenchment and consequent failure of all three projections. Then compare each stock's split-adjusted closing prices with its last close before the relevant failure became public. Subsequent declines in all three would support the forecast.
